title: Medical operations - waiting-area presence (content assignment)
business_line: People present in the waiting area
business_metric: Counted sustained presences in the waiting area, one per person track
explanation: Measured: zone_occupancy - each tracked person whose box centre stays inside waiting_area (x 0.08-0.95, y 0.25-0.90) for at least 1.0 s. This is presence. It is NOT a waiting time and NOT a dwell measurement: the event carries no duration. The specification's waiting-zone dwell rule is NOT computed: the engine has no dwell-event kind. The two clips are a content assignment, not a proven scene fit.
scope_note: REDUCED SCOPE. Waiting-zone dwell is NOT delivered by this pack: zone_occupancy records that a person stayed in the waiting area for at least the minimum, and carries no duration, so no waiting time is measured. What is measured is sustained presence of a person in the waiting area. Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit.
content_assignment: Clip-to-pack assignment is by content, not a proven scene fit: people-detection is a room with people walking through and classroom is a teaching room with people seated and standing. Neither is a clinical waiting room.

zones.name: waiting_area
zones.measured: Measured with yolo11n-fp16 at 5 fps (conf 0.25, iou 0.45): people-detection person centroid x 0.015..0.950, y 0.356..0.885 (187 observations); classroom person x 0.167..0.739, y 0.468..0.692 (659 observations). The zone brackets both measured ranges with a margin that excludes the frame border.

delivered_event: Delivered event: zone_occupancy - sustained presence in the waiting area. NOT a waiting time. NOT a dwell measurement.
